# Member of Technical Staff, Product Engineering

## Location

San Francisco

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

On-site

## Department

Engineering

## Why join Intelligence

**Mission:** Give every human superintelligence, and make superintelligence more human.

[Intelligence](https://intelligence.ai/) is the product lab company behind [DesignArena](https://www.designarena.ai/) \- 5.2M+ users in 8 months, leaderboard referenced by Andrew Ng, Elon Musk, Demis Hassabis, and more. The team is incredibly talent-dense (11 from Harvard + Berkeley), backed by Tier 1 VC Index Ventures, YC, SV Angel, Lenny Rachitsky, Paul Graham, Figma Ventures, and one of the fastest-growing seed-stage startups in SF.

**Behind closed doors, we see what the models can do six months before the world does.** We are trusted by the best frontier model providers like OpenAI to rigorously evaluate the capabilities of state-of-the-art multimodal models across design, web dev, game dev, image, video, audio, slide generation, and more, through the large-scale platforms that we’ve built.

**Design Arena, our flagship product, is the most referenced benchmark for AI-generated visuals, and is powered by over 5.3M+ authentic users across 192 countries.** Prediction Arena was the first time models traded autonomously with real cash on real-time, real-world events. Social Arena tested whether AI models can effectively grow and engage audiences on [X](https://x.com/) by having them operate as independent social media agents.

## **Role**

**You'll help build and evolve Design Arena, the platform where 5.2+ million users turn regular product interactions into valuable nuggets of learnable information.** You'll own products end-to-end across the stack, improving user experiences while building the distributed systems and platform infrastructure that power millions of real-time interactions.

We have enough flex on the team for you to choose to focus only on infrastructure / backend problems, only on frontend features, or something in between!

You'll ship new product capabilities, improve system reliability and performance, and scale Design Arena as we expand to new products and modalities.

## **What You’ll Own**

- Own the entire product

- Run A/B test and constantly experiment for SOTA human-model interaction experiences in a data-driven way

- Work with our world-class founding designer to make your product-interaction dreams come true

- Own features and systems from design through deployment, continuously iterating based on user feedback and product needs


## **What We’re Looking For**

- Experience building great products. You've built user-facing applications, backend services, or distributed systems that run in production, and you care about performance, reliability, and low latency.

- Bonus: Show us a product you’ve built before that you’re proud of!

- You like owning products end-to-end. You're excited by improving existing products, shipping new features, and solving real user problems.


## Details

- **Location:** San Francisco, Levi’s Plaza. We sponsor visas and handle relocation.

- **Work Schedule:** Sunday-Friday. Saturdays are yours!

- **Compensation:** Competitive salary + meaningful equity. You'd be joining at the stage when ownership matters most.
